slides.title: Someone made every AI tool a plugin — and 158k engineers noticed.
slides.sub: DeepSeek Harness quietly reframed how agents get their capabilities. Here's why it matters.

slides.label: My Take
slides.text: The winner in agents won't own the model — it'll own the plugin interface everything else has to speak.

slides.title: How the harness works
steps: Every capability — tools, memory, models — is a hot-swappable plugin.
The harness routes an agent's intent to the right plugin at runtime.
New abilities ship without touching the core — just drop in a plugin.

left.title: The old way
items: Every new tool = a code change

right.title: The harness way
items: New tools drop in, zero core changes

slides.label: stars in under 90 days
slides.sub: One of the fastest-growing agent repos of the year.

slides.title: How I'd apply it
items: CTO: standardize your internal tools as plugins now — cut future rewrites.
CEO: your moat isn't the model; it's the interface competitors must integrate with.
Both: bet on composability over any single vendor's stack.
